Grade: Grade 8
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Numbers 1.4 Squares and Square roots (6 lessons) Squares and square roots of num
Topic 1.5: Rates, Ratio, Proportions and Percentages
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 14

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Rates, Ratio, Proportions and Percentages, part of Numbers 1.4 Squares and Square roots (6 lessons) Squares and square roots of num in Grade 8 MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How do we use rates in real-life situations? 2. How do we use ratios in daily activities?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify rates in different situations,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Rates, Ratio, Proportions and Percentages in the Kenya CBC curriculum.

I. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. time while doing different activities such as calling, using for example different mobile service providers,

2. role-play this activity and note time taken to call, record on a table and compare,

3. use cut outs from whole objects or substances to relate fractions to ratios,

4. discuss and compare ratios from the cut outs,

5. discuss and share quantities of concrete objects in different ratios,

6. discuss and determine percentage increase and decrease of different quantities. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. time while doing different activities such as calling, using for example different mobile service providers,
2. role-play this activity and note time taken to call, record on a table and compare,
3. use cut outs from whole objects or substances to relate fractions to ratios,
4. discuss and compare ratios from the cut outs,
5. discuss and share quantities of concrete objects in different ratios,
6. discuss and determine percentage increase and decrease of different quantities. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Rates, Ratio, Proportions and Percentages together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical thinking and Problem solving: as the learner carries out different activities such as calling using different service

providers to determine calling rates.

• Imagination and Creativity: as the learner uses hourglass to show indirect relationships.

10

Values

• Respect: as the learner shares out different quantities of items in given ratios.

• Fairness: as the learner shares out quantities in different proportions or percentages.

Values:

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Social cohesion: is enhanced as the learner role-plays calling for a specified time and also charges from different telecom

service providers.

• Decision making: as the learner uses ratios to divide quantities such as money to different items , as part of consumer

awareness.

Link to other learning areas

• Agriculture: as the learner works out ratios of ingredients in various aspects of home care e.g. baking.

• Pre-technical Studies: as the learner works out ratios or proportions of different building materials.
